settings.question: Do you ship across India?
settings.answer: Yes. Free shipping on prepaid orders. COD available where supported.

settings.question: What is your return / refund policy?
settings.answer: See our Refund Policy page for full details on returns and replacements.

settings.question: What are the ingredients?
settings.answer: Kesha Mula includes pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, black sesame, halim, amla, bhringraj, ashwagandha, moringa, fenugreek, shatavari, beetroot, curry leaf and more. See the Ingredients page for details.

settings.question: Can I use this during pregnancy?
settings.answer: Please consult your healthcare professional before use if pregnant, breastfeeding or on medication.

settings.question: Is it for men and women?
settings.answer: Yes — formulated for adults (typically 25–45) experiencing hair fall, thinning and weak roots.

settings.question: Can children use it?
settings.answer: JustNatur products are designed for adult use. Consult a paediatric professional for anyone under 18.

settings.question: How do I use Kesha Mula?
settings.answer: One serving every morning mixed with water, buttermilk or juice on an empty stomach. Continue for 90 days.

settings.question: How do I use Kesha Amrith Oil?
settings.answer: Warm a few drops and massage into the scalp 2–3 times a week. Leave on before washing.

settings.question: Any side effects?
settings.answer: Made from food-based and botanical ingredients. Reduce or stop if discomfort occurs. Professional advice takes priority.

settings.question: How should I store products?
settings.answer: Keep sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

settings.question: When will I see results?
settings.answer: Hair grows on roughly a 90-day cycle. Many notice reduced shedding earlier. Individual results vary — we make no permanent guarantees.
